Flu Shot Clinics
Every Monday in October the Koochiching County Public Health will be conducting flu shots from 8:30AM to 2:30PM Read on...
Drop-off Box for Tax Payments
Paying your taxes just got a little easier! A secured drop-off box has been mounted on the exterior of the courthouse near the entrance by the Auditor-Treasurer's Office. It's a great alternative to paying online or mailing your property tax payments. Read on...
